narrative.overview:
Nexus presents high-speed native proxy and tunnel operation as a crisp, modern flagship Bento card console calibrated to Clash Verge Rev and FlClash across Desktop (Slint v1.19 + C++26) and Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Material 3 Adaptive). Daily one-second operation is organized into a responsive multi-column Bento grid of proportional, single-level `12px`-radius (`12dp`) cards resting on a layered cool mist-slate (`#f4f6f9`) or deep slate-obsidian (`#0f141c`) canvas ground: Quick-Control Tiles, Outbound Mode & Subscription Quota, Realtime Network Speed, Multi-Column Quick Server Tiles, and a `2×2` Connectivity & Inbound Matrix. Alongside the dashboard, a full-capability Profiles & Subscriptions console exposes subscription group tabs, instant URI/clipboard import, and structured visual editors across all 13 Nexus outbound protocols (`VLESS`, `Trojan`, `Hysteria2`, `TUIC`, `WireGuard`, `MASQUE`, `Shadowsocks-2022`, `AnyTLS`, `Naive`, `Snell`, `SSH`, `SOCKS5`, `HTTP`), Policy Groups, Proxy Chains, and Advanced Custom Configurations.

Every material and layout decision honors Nexus's zero-bloat native architecture. Cards separate cleanly from the canvas via `1px` (`1dp`) structural hairlines and tonal contrast with zero drop shadows, while continuous user-adjustable translucency (`40%–100%` `window-opacity` on Desktop, `50%–100%` `surfaceAlpha` on Android, with no Reduced Motion toggle in settings) lets the console sit lightly over desktop wallpapers when desired. The system explicitly rejects austere borderless monograph sheets, full-width horizontal ribbon strips, nested cards-inside-cards, drop-shadow elevation soup, hollow Standby dashboards, multi-hue neon telemetry rainbows, kickers or eyebrows above headings, and decorative monospace on UI prose.
keyCharacteristics: Layered cool mist-slate (`#f4f6f9`) and deep slate-obsidian (`#0f141c`) canvas grounds framing single-level `12px`-radius (`12dp`), `1px`-bordered (`#e2e8f0` / `#263142`) functional cards, plus an optional warm Studio Amber (`#12100e` / `#1b1815`) dark preset.

Decoupled semantic signal pair combining Electric Cobalt (`#2563eb` / `#60a5fa`) for primary interactive state and `RX` download telemetry with Signal Emerald (`#059669` / `#10b981`) for live tunnel confirmation, `TX` upload telemetry, and fast RTT (`< 80ms`).

Recessed segmented controls (`#eef2f6` / `#f1f5f9` light, `#1e2736` / `#263244` dark) with elevated solid card-fill active pills (`#ffffff` / `#171e29` or `primaryContainer`) and borderless interior `well-bg` rows that prevent nested card borders.

Continuous surface translucency (`0.40..1.0` `Theme.window-opacity` on Desktop with opt-in native backdrop blur; `0.50..1.0` `surfaceAlpha` + API 31+ Material You Dynamic Color on Android) with zero resting or modal drop shadows.
Crisp platform sans-serif UI hierarchy paired with tabular monospace (`tnum`) strictly for endpoints, ports, latencies, byte rates, protocol badges, and clocks.

rules.name: The Decoupled Signal Pair Rule
rules.body: Interactive selection and download (`RX`) telemetry use Electric Cobalt (`#2563eb` light / `#60a5fa` dark), while live tunnel confirmation, upload (`TX`) telemetry, and fast RTT (`< 80ms`) use Signal Emerald (`#059669` light / `#10b981` dark); electric-purple or multi-hue SaaS rainbows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Hue-Tinted CTA Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary action cues and inline latency readouts inside the filled `52px`/`52dp` primary tunnel button must use hue-tinted Cobalt Wash (`#dbeafe`) in Standby and pale emerald/white (`#d1fae5` / `rgba(255,255,255,0.9)`) when Connected—never muddy neutral gray.

rules.name: The Monospace Boundary Rule
rules.body: Monospace (`mono-kpi`, `mono-data`) is reserved strictly for endpoints, ports, latencies, throughput figures, clocks, memory counters, and short protocol codes; card titles, navigation items, and action verbs always set in platform sans-serif.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Lock Rule
rules.body: Every live throughput figure, uptime timer, active-flow pill, and RTT readout enforces `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (`tnum`) so 1Hz telemetry ticks never shift neighboring controls.

rules.name: The Single-Level Card Rule
rules.body: Top-level functional groups live in `12px`-radius (`12dp`) `1px`-bordered cards on the `#f4f6f9` / `#0f141c` canvas ground, while interior groupings use borderless `well-bg` fills or `1px` dividers—never bordered cards nested inside cards.

rules.name: The Zero-Shadow Translucency Rule
rules.body: Resting, hovered, and modal surfaces render with zero drop shadows; hierarchy relies strictly on canvas-to-card luminance contrast, `1px` hairlines, and user-controlled continuous alpha (`0.40..1.0` Desktop, `0.50..1.0` Android).

dos: Do frame each top-level dashboard and workspace module as a single-level `12px`-radius (`12dp`) card (`#ffffff` light / `#171e29` dark) with a `1px` (`1dp`) hairline border (`#e2e8f0` / `#263142`) on the `#f4f6f9` / `#0f141c` canvas ground.
Do use borderless interior `well-bg` fills (`#f8fafc` / `#f1f5f9` light, `#1e2736` dark) or `1px` flush dividers for switches, charts, subscription bars, and probe strips inside a card.

Do pair Electric Cobalt (`#2563eb` / `#60a5fa`) for interactive focus, Standby primary CTA, and `RX` download telemetry with Signal Emerald (`#059669` / `#10b981`) for Connected state, `TX` upload telemetry, and fast RTT (`< 80ms`).
Do populate the Dashboard Server Switcher from SQLite workspace profiles when in Standby and live policy-group members when Connected so all four console cards remain actionable in every state.
Do enforce `tnum` tabular numerals and monospace (`mono-kpi`, `mono-data`) exclusively on endpoints, ports, latencies, byte rates, protocol codes, and clocks.
Do preserve continuous user-adjustable surface translucency (`0.40..1.0` `window-opacity` on Desktop, `0.50..1.0` `surfaceAlpha` on Android) and `>= 48dp` interactive touch targets on Android.
donts: Don't nest `1px`-bordered cards inside other bordered cards or add drop shadows (`box-shadow`) to resting, hovered, or modal surfaces.
Don't revert to borderless `0px–4px` monograph ledger sheets or dark-only navigation spines in Light mode (`Sidebar` in Light mode stays crisp `#ffffff` on `#f4f6f9`).
Don't place kickers, uppercase eyebrows, or numbered `01 / 02` decorative labels above card or section titles.
Don't render neutral gray secondary text inside the filled Electric Cobalt or Signal Emerald primary tunnel CTA.
Don't introduce multi-hue neon rainbows into throughput charts or set prose, card titles, and UI action verbs in monospace.
Don't add an app-level Reduced Motion toggle to Desktop or Android appearance settings.
